title: Battle of Inlon River
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Inlon River", at revision 1382973505, opens: "The Battle of Inlon River was a major engagement of the Nian Rebellion, occurring in 1867." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4871280, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1867 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
